description: Works out transfer (stamp) duty, any foreign buyer surcharge and the total on an established home bought whole, in any Australian state or territory, from HomeReady Australia's rules file: general rates, home and owner-occupier rates, first home buyer exemptions and concessions. Returns the figures, the rate or concession used, notes giving the conditions, exact=false where a lower amount may apply that isn't worked out, and the rules used. Not covered: new homes, off-the-plan, vacant land, a purchase where only some buyers are foreign persons, and Queensland claims on part of a property. General information only; the revenue office decides eligibility.

first_home_buyer.description: Every buyer is a first home buyer (default false)

foreign_buyer.description: Every buyer is a foreign person for the state's surcharge (default false: none is)

live_in.description: A buyer will live in it as their home (default: the same as first_home_buyer). In Queensland a buyer who won't live in it gets no concession on their share, and Western Australia's first home owner rate needs every buyer to live there: the notes say so.

price.description: Price (or dutiable value) in whole Australian dollars

state.description: State or territory where the home is

name: calculate_stamp_duty
title: Calculate Australian stamp duty
